sentences.en: He cried thinking about his ordeal and its unending aftermath.
sentences.zh: 1. 想起那段折磨人的经历及其无尽的后果，他不禁哭了起来。

sentences.en: Throughout the aftermath of the explosion, Jason's easiness unsettled the survivors.
sentences.zh: 2. 爆炸后的余波中，杰森的轻松态度让幸存者感到不安。

sentences.en: In aftermath of the accident he lost his sight.

phrases.zh: 1. 在...之后：在某事发生后的一段时间里

senses.zh: 后果，影响；（尤指灾难或不愉快事件的）余波，后续影响
